plan.stopping_rule: Complete all six planned valid processes unless safety, validity or user interruption requires stopping. Do not stop early for a favorable result or silently discard a failure.
plan.final_settings: Restore original maximum textures, flag on, cache 10 GB, HAGS unchanged
